auth.usernameHint: 3–32 characters. Letters, numbers, dots, dashes and underscores.
auth.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. No other rules — pick something long and kind to yourself.

signup.title: Make an account
signup.subtitle: Just a name and a password — no email needed.
signup.recoveryNote: Next, we'll show you a one-time recovery code. Keep it somewhere safe.
signup.closedText: This instance is invite-only for now. Ask the admin to open signups or create an account for you.

recover.title: Reset with a recovery code
recover.subtitle: Enter the recovery code you saved when you signed up.
recover.noCode: No code? Ask the admin for a temporary password.

welcome.title: Save your recovery code
welcome.text: This code is shown only once. It is the only way to reset your password without the admin.
welcome.printHint: Tip: print it, or copy it into your password manager.
welcome.warning: If you lose this code, you'll need to ask the admin for help.
welcome.settingsText: Store it somewhere safe. Your previous code no longer works.

setup.title: Set up Wishlisto
setup.subtitle: Create the one admin account for this instance.
setup.text: The admin can manage signups and reset passwords, but never sees private lists or wishes.

auth.disabled: This account is disabled. Ask the admin for help.

lists.title: My lists
lists.subtitle: Everything you're hoping for, in one cosy place.
lists.emptyText: Make a list for a birthday, a rainy day, or just because.
lists.privateHint: Only you can see this list.

listForm.name: List name
listForm.notePlaceholder: Anything you want to remember about this list.

listPage.emptyText: Paste a link or add something by hand — no pressure.
listPage.emptySharedText: The owner hasn't added any wishes yet.
listPage.deleteConfirm: Delete this list and all its wishes? This can't be undone.
listPage.groupViewHint: This list is shared with one of your groups. Only the owner can edit it.
listPage.publicViewHint: Shared with you. Log in to claim a gift. You decide whether the owner can see that it is yours.
listPage.publicViewFooter: Shared with Wishlisto. Only the owner can edit this list.

listPage.noGroups: You're not in any groups yet.

listPage.publicRegenerateConfirm: Create a new public link? The old link will stop working.

itemForm.title: Title

itemForm.notesPlaceholder: Size, colour, a shop you trust…

itemActions.deleteConfirm: Delete this wish? This can't be undone.
itemActions.noOtherList: Make another list to move wishes there.

groups.title: Groups
groups.subtitle: Little circles for sharing wishlists with the people you love.
groups.emptyText: Create a group and invite people with a single link.
groups.name: Group name
groups.noLists: No lists shared with this group yet.
groups.noListsOwner: Share one of your lists with this group to get started.
groups.shareListText: Choose one of your lists. Only you can edit it.
groups.shareListEmpty: You don't have any lists yet.
groups.removeListConfirm: Stop sharing this list with the group?

groups.inviteRotateConfirm: Create a new invite link? The old one will stop working.
groups.inviteDisableConfirm: Disable the invite link? Nobody can join with the old link.
groups.noInvite: Invites are closed for this group.

groups.noWishesYet: No wishes in this list yet.

admin.title: Admin
admin.subtitle: Small but mighty controls for this instance.
admin.signupText: When signups are open, anyone who finds this instance can create an account.
admin.usersText: Reset a password to generate a temporary one. The person must choose a new password when they log in.
admin.resetConfirm: Reset {username}'s password? They will be signed out everywhere.
admin.tempPasswordText: Share it privately. It is shown only once.
admin.noClaims: Private lists stay private. Admins can never see anyone's lists, wishes or claims.
admin.campaignText: Show one short message at the top of the home pages, for example a holiday reminder.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Make this little corner feel like yours.
settings.accountText: Your username is how friends will find you later. There's no email address to manage.
settings.mustChangeText: The admin gave you a temporary password. Pick a new one to continue.
settings.adminText: Open the admin page to manage signups and reset passwords.
settings.passwordHint: Changing your password signs you out on other devices.
settings.recoveryText: Generate a fresh code. Your old code stops working immediately.
settings.dangerText: This removes your lists, wishes, photos and account. It cannot be undone.
settings.dangerConfirm: Delete your account and everything in it? This can't be undone.
settings.lastAdmin: The only admin can't delete their account. Transferring admin isn't available yet.
